We're no strangers to love
lyrics.translatedLyric: 我们对爱不陌生

lyrics.originalLyric: You know the rules and so do I
lyrics.translatedLyric: 你知道规则，我也是

lyrics.originalLyric: A full commitment's what I'm thinking of
lyrics.translatedLyric: 我在构思一份完整的承诺

lyrics.originalLyric: You wouldn't get this from any other guy
lyrics.translatedLyric: 你不会从其他老哥那里收到的承诺

lyrics.originalLyric: I just wanna tell you how I'm feeling
lyrics.translatedLyric: 我只想告诉你我的感受

lyrics.originalLyric: Gotta make you understand
lyrics.translatedLyric: 定要让你理解

lyrics.originalLyric: Never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down
lyrics.translatedLyric: 绝对不会放弃你，绝对不会辜负你

lyrics.originalLyric: Never gonna run around and desert you
lyrics.translatedLyric: 绝对不会围着你转又抛弃你

lyrics.originalLyric: Never gonna make you cry, never gonna say goodbye
lyrics.translatedLyric: 绝对不会让你哭，绝对不会说再见

lyrics.originalLyric: Never gonna tell a lie and hurt you
lyrics.translatedLyric: 绝对不会说谎来伤害你

lyrics.originalLyric: We've known each other for so long
lyrics.translatedLyric: 我们已经认识了很久

lyrics.originalLyric: Your heart's been aching but you're too shy to say it

lyrics.originalLyric: Inside we both know what's been going on
lyrics.translatedLyric: 我们心里都明白发生了什么

lyrics.originalLyric: We know the game and we're gonna play it
